meta.title: A Cincinnati day in selected stops
meta.summary: The Connector’s official map makes a shorter route possible without riding the whole loop.

sourceRefs.label: City of Cincinnati · How to Ride the Connector

blocks.text: The City of Cincinnati’s Connector map gives each station a number and name. A visitor can begin at Findlay Market–Race (12), continue through Liberty & Race (13) and Washington Park (14), then follow the map toward the Public Library (16), Fountain Square (18), and The Banks (1). This sequence carries the ride from Over-the-Rhine toward downtown and the riverfront; you can stop at Washington Park or another listed station instead of riding every segment. The City says the service is fare-free and describes level boarding and audio and visual stop information. These are vehicle details, not a guarantee about each sidewalk, curb, or destination entrance. Check the operator’s current service alerts and route information before setting out.
